Name: Schnuffel Bunny Plushes
Author: kittnet
Description:
A small content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], of Schnuffel and Schnuffelienchen, who you might recognise from 'Snuggle Song', 'Bunny Party', 'Kiss Me, Hold Me, Love Me', from Jamster/Jamba.
If you aren't familiar with how to use Alternative Textures, please make sure to read the description on its mod page!!
